svg.title: Invoice Assistant: Copilot Studio new harness
svg.desc: One agent, modular workflows, human review, optional Azure tools and Dynamics 365, SAP or other ERP adapters.
svg.text: Invoice Assistant | Start with the customer goal
Choose the workflows, tools and rules each customer needs. Pause unusual cases for a person.
Answers questions | Explains blockers | Requests the right next action
OPTIONAL WORKFLOWS - enable independently or combine
Uncertain fields, unusual amounts, duplicate / fraud flags
Pause > assigned reviewer > correct / reject / escalate > revalidate
Plug in customer rules and tools; keep the same three business workflows.
CONNECTED TOOLS - select for the customer's needs and total cost
Choose Azure only if processing, storage, review and support total cost is lower; savings are not guaranteed.
Modular by design: sources | extraction | rules | approvals | finance | archive
Copilot Studio keeps orchestration. New customer requirements extend selected steps, not duplicate the solution.
